diagnosis: The invoice retrieval route relies on express-openapi-validator to enforce parameter formats (e.g. UUID), but performs no object-level authorization check. Once the parameter passes schema validation, the handler queries InvoiceDb solely by req.params.invoiceId without scoping by the caller's organization or customer identity.
